title: MUSON: A Reasoning-oriented Multimodal Dataset for Socially Compliant Navigation in Urban Environments
reasoning: The paper focuses on robotics navigation and social compliance (following social norms such as yielding to pedestrians). While 'social norms' are related to behavioral expectations, the study is a technical robotics/navigation benchmark and does not evaluate religious beliefs, theological frameworks, or philosophical ethics/morals in a way that constitutes a core component of the work.
